integrated_findings.claim: P0 is internally coherent historical inventory evidence; all 38 frozen caller names and all 21 frozen trigger names remain structurally resolvable.

Current semantic equivalence and current-universe totality are not certified: 22/38 empirical md5(prosrc) differ, canonical historical hash representation is unknown, and bounded current scans expose complements and misses relative to P0.
No causal performance improvement/regression is demonstrated because null/zero semantics, non-additive stage accounting, reuse and matched intervention boundaries are unresolved.
Current research is read-only for IG execution; recorded Curator/Validator labels are distinct where present, but canonical historical authority and material independence remain unverified.
Existing cache/context/manifest/receipt surfaces support reuse-first verification; no runtime repair, duplicate removal or new observability subsystem is justified by current evidence.

Canonical provenance proves valid authority and material Curator/Validator independence.
